member: Farah — Post-Harvest and Cooperative Operations Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, the cloudy-day rule can be run by non-technical users on the device.

Plain words, the cooperative adds no warm crates until sun returns, and labelled crates make that visible at the door. Numbers are 200 kg per day normal intake needing 2.00 kWh batch electric from the daily batch electric for 200 kg (E55), paused to stay inside 1.42 days holding-only from the autonomy days holding only (E66), sane against one household day of fridge use.

Kofi, the racking still fits people, crates and cleaning on the device.

Plain words, two low side shelves leave a walkway with air gaps for cold air and mopping, with stock rotation by date labels. Numbers are 600 by 400 mm crates from the Best Folding Vented 600x400 Plastic Crates (E26), about 60 crates stacked 3 high with 100 mm gaps and 900 mm door from the Interior plan and section (E36), sane against a bucket of water per lift and a household doorway, where First-In-First-Out (FIFO) means oldest crates sold first.

Ready, because daily intake cap, no-batch cloudy rule, and washable racking close cooperative use.
